answer: Unclear. Multiple complaints and a low luggage-capacity score show a real, cross-cutting problem with boot size and tailgate reliability, but none of the provided signals or feedback include customer age or demographic breakdown — so we cannot conclude this is “just a habit of older customers.”
suggested_change: Add a demographic check to the acceptance criteria: track owner-reported boot faults by age group and require either (a) faults <1% in each major age segment or (b) a report showing faults are not concentrated in older customers before relaxing the requirement.
